jobs.description: Jobbeschreibung Wer wir sind benuta ist eine Designmarke für Wohnräume: eigene Kollektionen, Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa und über 150 Menschen in der Gruppe, vom Design über E-Commerce bis zur eigenen Logistik. Wir bauen unsere Multibrand-Strategie aus und entwickeln neben benuta weitere Marken. Worum es geht benuta arbeitet AI-first. Nicht als Projekt, sondern als Betriebsmodell. Jede Marke, jedes Team und jeder Prozess läuft auf derselben Grundlage: benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet. Nexus Cortex: Wissen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen. Eine Wahrheit, an einem Ort. Nexus Flow: jede Aufgabe und jeder Ablauf, nachvollziehbar und automatisierbar. Nexus Core: Konten, Zugänge und Ablage als Fundament. Die Architektur steht, KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen laufen. Jetzt geht es um Adoption: Jedes Team arbeitet vollständig in benuta Nexus, und aus Prozessen werden durchgängige, KI-gestützte Workflows. Warum wir das machen Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist. Deine Aufgaben Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows. benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden. jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description: Société O’CD est une enseigne spécialisée dans l’achat, la vente et l’échange de CD, DVD, BLU-RAY et JEUX VIDEO. Ses magasins sont présents à LILLE, PARIS, LYON, GRENOBLE, GENEVE, MARSEILLE, MONTPELLIER, TOULOUSE, BORDEAUX, NANTES, TOURS et RENNES. Depuis presque 30ans, O’CD se construit par passion avec des personnes qui considèrent le partage culturel comme la valeur moteur de leur enthousiasme. Son concept original fait d’O’CD un groupe pérenne et tourné vers l’avenir. Les références sont renouvelées constamment grâce à l’achat, la vente et le troc. A l’heure où le téléchargement occupe une place importante sur le marché, O’CD continue à se développer grâce à ses valeurs solides, son équipe de passionnés, son expertise du produit et sont esprit recycler. Rejoignez-nous pour faire partie de l’aventure ! Descriptif du poste Rattaché au chef de projets informatiques, le stagiaire participera à la conception et à l'amélioration des interfaces d’applications. Il interviendra sur l'ensemble du processus de conception et pourra, selon son profil, participer à l'intégration front-end des interfaces réalisées. Ses missions principales seront de concevoir des parcours utilisateurs simples et efficaces, réaliser des wireframes, maquettes et prototypes, améliorer l'ergonomie et l'accessibilité d'applications existantes. Ce stage permettra d'acquérir une expérience concrète dans la conception et la réalisation d'interfaces professionnelles au sein d'une équipe de développement. Profil recherché Étudiant en UX/UI Design, Design numérique ou formation équivalente (minimum Bac+3). Bonne maîtrise d'un outil de conception tel que Figma. Sensibilité aux problématiques d'expérience utilisateur et d'ergonomie. Bonnes connaissances en HTML, CSS et JavaScript. Connaissances des principes de design responsive et d'accessibilité. Une expérience avec le framework front-end Vue.js est un plus. Autonomie, curiosité, organisation et esprit d'initiative. Nous recherchons avant tout une person

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: About Us Gather AI is the Physical AI platform for logistics. We give the companies that run the world’s warehouses ground truth on every product and every movement, dock to dock. Our platform reads the warehouse floor through autonomous drones and cameras mounted on material handling equipment, then turns what it sees into intelligence and action. Facilities run safer and more accurately, with fewer ladders and fewer manual counts. If you want to do the defining design work for a new category in a vital industry, we’d like to meet you. About the Team Product at Gather AI sits at an unusual intersection: we build software for people who work on warehouse floors, not at desks. Our users are associates checking inventory on a tablet from the seat of a forklift, shift teams running drone workflows, field technicians troubleshooting on site, and facility leaders reading AI-generated insights in Sage. Design here is about more than pixels, though craft matters a lot. It starts with understanding how people work under pressure, and it ends with software that gets out of their way and looks as advanced as the technology behind it. About the Role Most design roles ask you to improve something that already exists. This one asks you to define what good looks like for a new category of product. You’ll be Gather AI’s first and only designer. You’ll own design end to end, from field research and information architecture to visual craft and working prototypes. Your work spans the apps floor teams use alongside our drones and MHE Vision systems, and Sage, our AI insights layer. The job is to help the product team ship products that solve real problems and happen to be very well designed, not to make screens for their own sake. You won’t design from assumptions. You’ll stand next to the people using our software and let what you see shape what you build. jobs.description: Join SE3 Labs as Senior Designer You'll be our first designer, and you'll own every kind of design at SE3 except hardware. That means how the company looks, how it talks to the world, and how it feels to use our software. There's a foundation to start from, but it's your job to take it to the next level and build a system that helps execute with the highest quality and speed. Execution should be at the heart of all you do. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Brand & Communications team , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. What you will own Brand and identity Communication and marketing Website and social Product (UI/UX) Print & Tradeshow collateral Your Profile 6+ years of design experience across both brand and product. You don't have to be equally strong at everything, but you should be excellent at one and very good at the other, and your portfolio should show both. Real craft. Your typography, layout and detail are sharp. You can make something look polished, and you also know when it should look like an engineering document. Systems thinking. You build design systems and component libraries that last, and you can explain the decisions behind them. Product UX depth. You've designed complex, data-dense software where clarity matters a great deal. Experience with mission-critical, industrial, aerospace

jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description: At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries. How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build. This is what you'll do Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work. Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in. Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team. Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time. Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next

jobs.title: Graphic Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: 🛠️ Wir sind Gauder. Wir machen DIY-Produkte besser. 🌍 Seit 2017 haben über 3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden in Europa und den USA bei uns bestellt. Heute sind es mehr als 100.000 Bestellungen im Monat. 🎨 Ob im Geschäft oder auf Amazon: Der erste visuelle Eindruck entscheidet in Sekunden, wer zugreift und wer weitergeht. Darum ist Design bei uns kein Nebenthema, sondern ein wichtiger Hebel für unseren Erfolg. 🤝 Gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Design gestaltest du, wie unsere Kundinnen und Kunden Gauder erleben: auf der Verpackung, im Amazon-Listing und in jeder Präsentation. Dein Bereich gehört dir. Du kannst Dinge direkt verändern, siehst unmittelbar, was sie bewirken, und legst Wert auf die Details, an denen andere sparen. Beginn: ab sofort Anstellung: Vollzeit, unbefristet Ort: Berlin (Mitte) Aufgaben Verpackungen: Du gestaltest Verpackungen für neue und bestehende Produkte, vom ersten Entwurf bis zur druckfertigen Datei. Listings: Du erstellst Produktbilder, Infografiken und A+ Content für unsere Amazon-Listings in ganz Europa. Präsentationen: Du gibst unseren Präsentationen die Form, mit der sie sich von der Masse austauschbarer Decks abheben: klar, prägnant und unverwechselbar. Designsystem: Du denkst in visuellen Systemen statt in Einzelstücken und siehst unsere Marken nicht als fertiges Regelwerk, sondern als etwas, das mit dem Unternehmen wächst. Du entwickelst die Designsprache laufend weiter und hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, auch deine eigenen. Qualifikation Ausbildung: Du hast Grafik- oder Kommunikationsdesign studiert (Universität, FH, Kolleg) oder eine Ausbildung gemacht. Dein Können und dein Portfolio sind uns wichtiger als dein Abschluss. Erfahrung: Du hast 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Grafikdesign, idealerweise mit Print-Projekten oder im E-Commerce. Tools: Du arbeitest routiniert mit der Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop etc.) und Figma. Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau. Auge fürs Detail: Dir falle

jobs.title: Lead Designer / Design System Owner (f/x/m) in Tech & Data Team
jobs.description: Our design system is the shared foundation behind the experiences millions of musicians use on thomann.de . It provides consistent components and guidelines for our product teams so they can build faster and focus on what makes each experience unique. The Design System Team sits within our Product Division, alongside Product Design and Product Research, and brings together a Design System Architect and a group of frontend engineers who turn design decisions into robust, reusable code. We treat the design system as a product in its own right, with its own users, roadmap and priorities. Tjark, Tobias & Heiko are our Frontend Engineers, building and improving the components our shop is made of and making sure every team can use them with ease. Juliane designs the components that bring our shop to life as our Design System Architect, owns our Figma and accessibility libraries and helps new designers find their way. And that’s where you come in : As our Product Owner, you help us decide what matters most, keep close contact with the many teams who rely on our Design System and roll up your sleeves as a designer to shape our components hands-on. We work remote, distributed, together: Whether fully remote within Germany or on-site in our offices in Berlin & Erlangen - always as a team, always customer-oriented and data-driven. Here’s what you’ll be doing Own and maintain the design system roadmap, documentation and backlog, aligned with the needs of consuming product teams and with the division's process while following scrum events and existing formats in the team. Run intake and triage: collect requests from designers, engineers and product owners, make prioritization decisions, communicate them transparently and track adoption. Represent the design system in cross-team planning, and represent consuming teams' needs inside the design system team. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
jobs.description: Teamwork makes the stream work.   Roku is changing how the world watches TV Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.     About the team At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware. About the role As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow.
